content.value: What would be the problem when you write the following code segment. unique ptr<MyClass> myPtr(new MyClass()); unique ptr<MyClass> myPtr2=myPtr

How can you fix the problem using std::unique ptr, and are there any other smart pointers that could be used to solve this issue ? if so, explain how those alternative smart pointers can be utilized to resolve the problem.
